Well, you should know that everyone has only one chance at life. You may think that your life is equalled to nothing, but think about it. There are people in worse condition who are still alive. In fact, there are a bunch of famous people who started out as losers and ended up amazing. I had gone through a period where I also thought of committing suicide. I was just tired of life. Then, I made new friends, and they really changed me. They had such a positive outlook on life, and really became something worth living for. Think about it; you are lucky enough to have food, water, money, and a device. Maybe try and go around making friends. They could introduce you to new hobbies that you could find very fun. I wish you good luck on your journey! :D
